resize_image: resize a numpy array image to a target width and height using cv2 or pillow backend
rescale_image: rescale an image by a factor or max size while keeping the aspect ratio
rotate_image: rotate an image by a given angle with optional auto-bound and border mode settings
crop_image_patches: crop image patches from bounding boxes with optional scaling and padding
pad_image: pad an image to a target shape or with specified padding values and mode
